newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least 23 killed in Colombian massacres.
newsitem.headline: At least 23 killed in Colombian massacres.

text.p: At least 23 people, including an entire family hacked to death with machetes, were killed in attacks in central and northern Colombia, police said on Thursday.

A family of six were murdered by unidentified machete-wielding killers in San Miguel de Tena in central Boyaca province, and bullet-ridden bodies of 17 peasants were found scattered on the outskirts of Tolu Viejo in northern Sucre province on Thursday, police said.

There was no clear motive for the killings nor information on the identity of the killers but Sucre has seen a recent rash of attacks by right-wing paramilitary death squads and Boyoca is known as a stronghold of paramilitary groups.

Nearly 40 people died in a wave of killings attributed to paramilitary groups across northern Colombia two weeks ago and last month paramilitary forces from across Colombia held a summit in which they pledged to step up their war against leftist guerrillas and rebel sympathisers.
In a separate attack in Cucuta in northeast Norte de Santander province, a Roman catholic priest was gunned down by two unidentified killers on Wednesday evening, police said.
